summary.note: Diagnostic only. One same-day symbol/decision/setup episode contributes at most one statistical observation; variants are retained as metadata. Shadow outcomes may support profitability admission but must never loosen a hard live-money gate.

rules: Tracks accepted and rejected model candidates for opportunity-cost diagnostics and shadow-first profitability admission.
Counts at most one statistical shadow observation per same-day symbol/decision/setup episode; later variants are metadata only.
Uses future Alpaca daily bars only after the decision date; never uses future data to create the decision.
Shadow evidence may unlock reduced-size live probation only after configured sample/expectancy thresholds; it may never automatically increase maximum live risk or loosen a hard gate.
Robinhood real-fill history remains authoritative for actual-money performance and full admission.

dedupe.policy: Earliest same-day decision is the statistical representative. Later geometry changes are retained in variants and do not add independent wins/losses.
